approved_scope_ko: 동일 고정 source/bath의 단위 결속, 저장 scalar 산술, 두 birth 열의 올바른 재사용, A2의 명시적 thermal cutoff join 후보와 누적 source-energy 상계를 연구·보고 단계에 재사용한다. 실제 consumer 채택·물리 입력 정확도·cutoff thermalization 실증·전역 이력은 승인하지 않는다.

claims.claim: Actual Qe(W,t)=t A(W), proper-volume units and source amplitude are bound to saved 9600/M0 records.
claims.conditions: Pinned full-spectrum proton normalization, active 1-4 MeV collision source, selected 0.1-900 eV electron births, fixed xi=.01 bath and zero initial stock.

claims.claim: P(T)=q_star H0 R and E_heat(T)=q_star T H0 S/2 with recorded source scale; same-operator prompt errors in SI.
claims.conditions: Same linear source, heat-only passive causal kernel, original energy-normalized b; p is not the ramp response coefficient.

claims.claim: Already-weighted birth columns add without a second energy-fraction factor; same band-shape amplitude changes can be reused.
claims.conditions: Common original selected source scale; nonnegative amplitudes; unchanged bath and within-band spectral shape; normalized delay moments use heat-yield weights.

claims.claim: A2 explicit cutoff energy-and-number thermal join is an internally consistent fixed-volume closure candidate.
claims.conditions: P_th=P_heat+P_cut; S_thermal=S_cut; active nonthermal energy/number remain separate; actual stored cutoff energy and source-inclusive rates; prescribed frozen transport outputs. Not empirical proof of subcutoff thermalization or deployed receiver.

claims.claim: Cumulative outside-energy and calorimetric upper envelopes for the same recorded active-proton source.
claims.conditions: Zero outside initial stock; passive source-attributed kinetic energy; no borrowed bath energy; selected response fixed; nonnegative incoming thermal particle number. No general instantaneous-power bound or positive lower bound on DeltaT.

claims.claim: Automatic actual REI adoption, CR-on history or error-budget admission.
claims.reason: Selected observable, absolute/relative tolerance and reference denominator are null; the existing FS10 terminal receiver is a different output/particle-counting contract.

claims.claim: Physical input-accuracy certificate, cutoff independence, source/atomic/continuum/mesh validity or cosmological irrelevance.
claims.reason: Exact arithmetic and stored-record agreement add no such evidence. Original scientific gates remain.

claims.claim: All-free event-only expression as a completed alternative receiver closure.
claims.reason: Active energy reference and complete primary birth energy/count accounting are not closed; final DERIVATION explicitly excludes this interpretation.

criteria.evidence: Code, immutable historical receipts, preserved input scalars and current results were directly traced with explicit read scopes; SHA identity is not itself validity.
criteria.physical_math_validity: Dimensions, ramp time factors, birth weighting, number/energy conservation and thermal denominator are consistent within the declared assumptions.
criteria.novelty: New local source-to-observable unit binding and explicit thermal closure application; no claim of globally novel response or thermodynamic theorem, new physical experiment or new atomic information.
criteria.testability: Exact atomic-delay and open-calorimeter examples discriminate the principal normalization/counting errors; raw J1/J2 provide a separate recorded-data route.
criteria.robustness: Strictly limited to preserved source, bath, operator, original amplitude and initial condition; numerical/physical input uncertainty remains inherited.
criteria.tractability: Completed with lightweight scalar postprocessing and no new heavy work; selected source reuse is actionable.
criteria.assumptions: Passive stationary response only where invoked, zero prehistory, same frozen bath and spectral shape; A2 is a defined closure candidate.
criteria.original_motivation: Provides a concrete physical normalization and bounded thermal relevance calculation while retaining the actual consumer budget as unknown rather than substituting a different global question.

reference_execution.interpretation: Independent implementation and exact toy inputs; actual-record checks share historical physical inputs and do not independently validate that physics.

owner_execution_reviewed.meaning: Arithmetic consistency after unit/normalization conversion only, not an input-physics accuracy certificate.

clarifications.issue: T_0 used for both horizon and initial gas temperature; final text now T_g,0 for gas.
All-free event projection must not be promoted as completed energy-consistent alternative receiver; final text explicitly excludes it.
Evaluator uses B R002 coverage input while derivation cites C R001; whole identities differ but coverage subobjects including recorded decimals match.

consumer_budget.binding_scope: Executed BASS_CR fixed-bath electron source; REI selected CR-on history remains unprovided

report_pdf_scope: Final report/PDF still authoring and is not a mandatory reviewed artifact of this scientific decision. It must retain the approved scope above.
postdecision_bookkeeping: Owner may record this bounded decision in status/entrypoints and publication receipts while preserving frozen scientific evidence and the manifest reviewed here. Scientific code/result/claim changes require a new targeted review.
